authorization_context: Built after the project owner reviewed the missing-input report and instructed: Please go ahead and build everything.
arrivals: Poisson counts and uniform within-hour times; repeat an archival 24-hour forecast profile for warmup, then measure one cycle. This is not observed hospital demand.

parameters.name: triage_capacity
parameters.support: analyst-defined teaching experiment; no hospital or literature calibration

parameters.name: triage_duration
parameters.influence: controls triage workload; not an observed triage duration

parameters.name: treatment_capacity
parameters.influence: controls treatment and boarding concurrency; does not map directly to staff headcount

parameters.name: treatment_duration
parameters.support: analyst-defined; not derived from ED LOS

parameters.name: boarding_duration
parameters.support: analyst-defined; no boarding timestamps in local sources
parameters.influence: holds treatment resource after treatment; can create downstream pressure by construction

parameters.name: admitted_path_probability
parameters.baseline: computed from MIMIC demo ADMITTED disposition
parameters.influence: selected demo may overrepresent hospital admissions; not a probability for the Dryad hospital

parameters.name: initial_census
parameters.influence: warmup reduces but does not prove removal of empty-start bias

parameters.name: routing
parameters.baseline: arrival, FIFO triage, FIFO treatment, disposition, exit; admitted path retains resource while boarding
parameters.influence: no abandonment, acuity priority, staff schedules, blocking bed queue or fast-track mechanism

interpretation: Results describe this architecture and these scenario parameters only. Monte Carlo intervals omit structural and parameter uncertainty. No optimal staffing, actual hospital bottleneck or patient benefit is claimed.
